licensure.disciplinary_grounds.rationale: These nine buckets cover the full distribution: deceptive acts in obtaining or exercising a license (Fraud & Misrepresentation), skill/quality failures (Incompetence & Negligence), working without or beyond a license or aiding unlicensed persons (Unlicensed & Unauthorized Practice), abandonment/non-completion/departure from plans (Contract & Project Failures), diversion of funds/non-payment/financial irresponsibility (Financial Misconduct), violations of building codes/statutes/regulations (Regulatory & Code Violations), criminal convictions (Criminal Conviction), missing insurance/bond/workers'-comp (Insurance & Bond Deficiency), and failure to respond to orders/investigations/reporting requirements (Administrative Non-Compliance).

profession_specific.system_components_in.rationale: These seven buckets map cleanly onto the major functional subsystems repeatedly named across states: heat generation/delivery, cooling/refrigeration, ventilation/ductwork/air handling, hydronic and process piping, fuel/gas supply lines, control wiring and sensors, and the remaining accessories (insulation, filters, boilers-as-vessels, water treatment, solar, etc.) that don't fit the first six.

profession_specific.qualifier_license_ty.rationale: The items cluster by trade scope: master-level HVACR credentials (DE, IA, MD, NJ, VA), broad mechanical contractor licenses (AK, FL mechanical, IA, LA, MI, OK, SC, TN), HVAC/air-conditioning specific contractor licenses (AL, FL AC, GA, OH, TX, WV), fuel gas and combustion technician licenses (ME, NH fuel gas types), specialty adjacent trades (MA sheet metal, NC plumbing/fire sprinkler, NH plumber/hearth), and vague statutory references (CT, HI chapter citations).

profession_specific.financial_responsibi.rationale: The items cluster into surety bonds (the dominant method), cash/deposit equivalents, letters of credit, general/property/performance liability insurance, workers' compensation insurance, audited or self-prepared financial statements demonstrating net worth, credit-score-based assessments, and a small residual group (self-insurer authorization, good-standing proof, financial responsibility course, questionnaire), covering the full distribution without an oversized catch-all.
